ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 (OceanLotus / Cobalt Kitty) Office macro to obfuscated PowerShell/LOLBin chain
ucs.description: Hunts the APT32 hallmark execution chain observed in the Cobalt Kitty intrusion: a weaponized Office document (commonly Vietnamese-language lure targeting ASEAN diplomats, dissidents, and APAC private sector) spawns powershell.exe or a script-host LOLBin carrying heavily obfuscated commands (FromBase64String, [char], -bxor, -join, IEX) that stage a Cobalt Strike beacon. Pairs APT32's signature delivery (T1566 / T1204.002), execution (T1059.001), and bespoke obfuscation tradecraft (T1027.010/.011/.013) in one query so a single Office-macro detonation surfaces.
ucs.splunk: | tstats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | rename Processes.* as * | where match(process, "(?i)-EncodedCommand|-enc\s|FromBase64String|DownloadString|DownloadFile|IEX|Invoke-Expression|\[char\]|-join\s|-bxor|WindowStyle\s+Hidden|-W\s+Hidden|Net\.WebClient|System\.Reflection\.Assembly") | where NOT match(user, "(?i)\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process_name process process_hash
ucs.kql:
let MalDocApps = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe"]);
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe"]);
let ObfMarkers = dynamic(["-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-EC ","FromBase64String","DownloadString","DownloadFile","IEX","Invoke-Expression","[char]","-join","-bxor","WindowStyle Hidden","-W Hidden","-NoP","-NonI","Net.WebClient","System.Reflection.Assembly"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (MalDocApps)
| where FileName in~ (ScriptHosts)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (ObfMarkers)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FileName,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let MalDocApps = dynamic(["WINWORD.EXE","EXCEL.EXE","POWERPNT.EXE","OUTLOOK.EXE"]);
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe"]);
let ObfMarkers = dynamic(["-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-EC ","FromBase64String","DownloadString","DownloadFile","IEX","Invoke-Expression","[char]","-join","-bxor","WindowStyle Hidden","-W Hidden","Net.WebClient","System.Reflection.Assembly"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentLeaf = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| extend ChildLeaf  = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where ParentLeaf in~ (MalDocApps)
| where ChildLeaf  in~ (ScriptHosts)
| where CommandLine has_any (ObfMarkers)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, AccountName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 OceanLotus Office Macro Spawns Obfuscated Script Host
id: 7f2a0c4d-3b9c-4f1d-9a2e-8c1f6a32d901
status: experimental
description: Detects the APT32 / OceanLotus / Cobalt Kitty execution chain where a malicious Office document spawns powershell.exe or a script-host LOLBin with command-line obfuscation markers used by their VBA stagers.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://www.cybereason.com/blog/operation-cobalt-kitty-apt
author: detection-engineering
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_office:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\WINWORD.EXE'
      - '\EXCEL.EXE'
      - '\POWERPNT.EXE'
      - '\OUTLOOK.EXE'
  child_script:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
  obfuscation:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'Net.WebClient'
      - 'WindowStyle Hidden'
      - '-W Hidden'
      - '[char]'
      - '-bxor'
      - 'System.Reflection.Assembly'
  condition: parent_office and child_script and obfuscation
falsepositives:
  - Enterprise Office add-ins legitimately invoking PowerShell with telemetry switches
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1027.010
  - attack.g0050
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\winword.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE) @CommandLine:(*EncodedCommand* OR *FromBase64String* OR *DownloadString* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *IEX* OR *Net.WebClient* OR *"WindowStyle Hidden"* OR *"-W Hidden"* OR *"[char]"* OR *-bxor* OR *System.Reflection.Assembly*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|mshta|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(-EncodedCommand|-enc\\s|FromBase64String|DownloadString|DownloadFile|IEX|Invoke-Expression|\\[char\\]|-bxor|-join\\s|WindowStyle\\s+Hidden|-W\\s+Hidden|Net\\.WebClient|System\\.Reflection\\.Assembly)", field=CommandLine)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, SHA256HashData], function=[count(), min(@timestamp), max(@timestamp)])
ucs.rationale: APT32 / OceanLotus is documented (Cybereason Cobalt Kitty, Volexity, FireEye, ESET) as relying on weaponized Vietnamese-language Word/Excel macro documents that drop and execute a Cobalt Strike PowerShell stager wrapped in heavy character-array and bxor obfuscation. ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 DLL side-loading via abused signed AV / Office binaries (OceanLotus persistence)
ucs.description: Hunts APT32's signature DLL side-loading tradecraft (T1574.002) where they pair a legitimately signed third-party binary (Symantec rastlsc.exe, McAfee mcoemcpy.exe/McOsce.exe, Avast wsc_proxy.exe, Adobe AcroTranscoder.exe, Google goopdate.exe) staged in a user-writable directory with a malicious lookalike DLL (rastls.dll, McUtil.dll, wsc.dll, Cookies_x64.dll). This pairing is one of the most reliably observed OceanLotus persistence patterns across Cobalt Kitty, the 2020 BISMUTH cryptomining cluster, and Canvas Cyclone reporting.
ucs.splunk: | tstats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("rastlsc.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","McOsce.exe","AcroTranscoder.exe","RtkAudUService64.exe","goopdate.exe","SymantecRastls.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | rename Processes.* as * | where match(process_path, "(?i)\\\\(AppData|ProgramData|Users\\\\Public|Temp|Downloads|PerfLogs|Windows\\\\Tasks)\\\\") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime dest user process_name process_path parent_process_name process process_hash
ucs.kql:
let APT32SideLoadHosts = dynamic(["rastlsc.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","McOsce.exe","AcroTranscoder.exe","RtkAudUService64.exe","goopdate.exe","SymantecRastls.exe"]);
let APT32SideLoadDLLs = dynamic(["rastls.dll","wsc.dll","cookies_x64.dll","mcutil.dll","acrotranscoder.dll","goopdate.dll","outlfltr.dll"]);
let SuspectPaths = dynamic([@"\appdata\",@"\programdata\",@"\users\public\",@"\temp\",@"\downloads\",@"\perflogs\",@"\windows\tasks\"]);
let ImageLoads = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (APT32SideLoadHosts) or FileName in~ (APT32SideLoadDLLs)
    | where FolderPath has_any (SuspectPaths) or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (SuspectPaths)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, ReportId,
              HostBinary = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              HostPath   = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              HostSHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256,
              LoadedDLL  = FileName,
              DLLPath    = FolderPath,
              DLLSHA256  = SHA256,
              User       = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let ProcLaunches = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ (APT32SideLoadHosts)
    | where FolderPath has_any (SuspectPaths)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              HostBinary = FileName,
              HostPath   = FolderPath,
              HostSHA256 = SHA256,
              LoadedDLL  = "",
              DLLPath    = "",
              DLLSHA256  = "",
              User       = AccountName;
union ImageLoads, ProcLaunches
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let APT32SideLoadHosts = dynamic(["rastlsc.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","McOsce.exe","AcroTranscoder.exe","RtkAudUService64.exe","goopdate.exe","SymantecRastls.exe"]);
let SuspectPaths = dynamic([@"\AppData\",@"\ProgramData\",@"\Users\Public\",@"\Temp\",@"\Downloads\",@"\PerfLogs\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ImageLeaf = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where ImageLeaf in~ (APT32SideLoadHosts)
| where NewProcessName has_any (SuspectPaths)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, AccountName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 OceanLotus DLL Side-Load Host Binary in User-Writable Path
id: 9e4b13a7-c5d8-4f2a-8e3b-72a5d1c4f7b2
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of signed third-party binaries that APT32 / OceanLotus has historically abused as DLL side-loading hosts (Symantec rastlsc.exe, McAfee McOsce/mcoemcpy.exe, Avast wsc_proxy.exe, Adobe AcroTranscoder.exe, Google goopdate.exe) when staged in user-writable directories.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2019/03/20/fake-or-fake-keeping-up-with-oceanlotus-decoys/
author: detection-engineering
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rastlsc.exe'
      - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
      - '\mcoemcpy.exe'
      - '\McOsce.exe'
      - '\AcroTranscoder.exe'
      - '\RtkAudUService64.exe'
      - '\goopdate.exe'
      - '\SymantecRastls.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\PerfLogs\'
      - '\Windows\Tasks\'
  condition: selection_image and selection_path
falsepositives:
  - Portable installers staging signed updater binaries (goopdate, RtkAudUService64) in ProgramData
level: high
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0050
